text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 15, 2024) for 460 Eglinton Avenue East.

The Property Standards Committee – North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (August 15, 2024) for 460 Eglinton Avenue East, Folder Number 24 198014 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to April 30, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
